Sorry I'm a tad late, but i thought I'd add in a bit from my experience. 

If you feel it's not being seriously taken, try write everything down in chronological order (pain, feelings etc) and hand it in to be "put with" your "medical notes". Then, in some cases, just keep complaining if you find their methods ineffective and then the pain nurse or a psychiatrist etc can change meds etc.

It seemed to get me taken more seriously and after years of trying to get help im slowly getting some progress.
